title: Software Developer - Petrophysics
description:
Software Developer - Petrophysics

Exp: 5-8 yrs

- Bachelor's in geology, geophysics, computer science, or engineering (Master's preferred)

- Min. 5 yrs software development, preferably in oil & gas with subsurface domain knowledge

- OOP including C++ and C#, Python, .NET Framework, Azure services, DevOps

- Parallel computing, AI/ML technologies, DevOps practices

- Software architecture & design patterns

- Authentication and cybersecurity protocols including OAuth

- Plus: OpenGL, Qt, OSDU; Petrel, Techlog, Studio and related subsurface tools

- Soft skills: problem-solving, attention to detail, verbal/written communication, independent and team working, adaptability, ability to mentor others

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
